section.title: Supplying a POS tagger and chunker
section.para: The core bottom-up parsers tag and chunk with the models packed in the ParserModel. The package opennlp.tools.parser.custom provides CustomTaggerParsers, which creates the parser for the model's type, chunking or tree insert, with a POSTagger you supply, and optionally a Chunker. Any tagger whose topKSequences returns scored sequences can drive the parse, for example a neural tagger.

The tags the tagger produces must match the tag set the parser model was trained on. The core constructor still builds the model's tagger and chunker once; they are replaced before the parser is returned and are never used. A null argument is rejected with an IllegalArgumentException.
